title: Orla: A Library for Serving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Rana Shahout; Hayder Tirmazi; Minlan Yu; Michael Mitzenmacher
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Agentic applications manually compose workflow orchestration, heterogeneous LLM backends, tools, context propagation, scheduling, and KV lifecycle policy, leaving no reusable workflow-level serving abstraction.
problem_statement.zh: agentic application 目前以人工方式組合 workflow orchestration、異質 LLM backend、tool、context propagation、scheduling 與 KV lifecycle policy，缺乏可重用的 workflow-level serving abstraction。

key_innovation.en: Orla is a backend-neutral serving library with a stage mapper, hierarchical workflow orchestrator, and workflow-aware memory manager that exposes explicit DAGs, per-stage scheduling hints, context builders, and preserve/flush cache policies across vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, or simulation.
key_innovation.zh: Orla 是 backend-neutral serving library，包含 stage mapper、階層式 workflow orchestrator 與 workflow-aware memory manager，並跨 vLLM、SGLang、Ollama 或 simulation 提供 explicit DAG、per-stage scheduling hint、context builder 與 preserve/flush cache policy。

key_improvements.en: Heterogeneous stage mapping reduces wall-clock time 38%, mean completion time 60%, and estimated inference cost 35%; workflow-level cache preservation improves the TTFT distribution, with no numeric magnitude stated.
key_improvements.zh: 異質 stage mapping 將 wall-clock time 降低 38%、mean completion time 降低 60%、estimated inference cost 降低 35%；workflow-level cache preservation 改善 TTFT distribution，但未載明數值幅度。

infra_layer: KV-cache reuse, Serving / scheduling, Control plane / interface

workloads_traces.en: SWE-bench Lite with 2,294 patch-generation requests; the first five sorted DAG-MATH-Formatted-CoT problems as multi-stage workflows; a four-stage customer-support demonstration with branching and tools.
workloads_traces.zh: SWE-bench Lite 的 2,294 個 patch-generation requests；排序後前五個 DAG-MATH-Formatted-CoT problems，以 multi-stage workflow 執行；另含具 branch 與 tool 的 four-stage customer-support demonstration。

key_parameters.en: One RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 96 GB; vLLM mapping experiment allocates 60% GPU memory to Qwen3-8B and 35% to Qwen3-4B, max context 32,768, temperature 0, max output 4,096; cache experiment uses SGLang/Qwen3-8B, temperature 0, max output 256; 956 of 2,294 requests route to 4B; compare flush per request versus flush per workflow; policies preserve on small increments and flush on backend/model switch, pressure, or workflow completion. Request rate, concurrency, tool durations, cache-pressure threshold, repetitions, and numeric TTFT reduction not stated; Ollama is also supported but is not a schema-canonical engine tag.
key_parameters.zh: 使用一張 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 96 GB；vLLM mapping experiment 將 60% GPU memory 配予 Qwen3-8B、35% 配予 Qwen3-4B，max context 32,768、temperature=0、max output 4,096；cache experiment 使用 SGLang/Qwen3-8B、temperature=0、max output 256；2,294 個 requests 中有 956 個路由至 4B；比較 flush per request 與 flush per workflow；policy 在 small increment 時 preserve，於 backend/model switch、pressure 或 workflow completion 時 flush。request rate、concurrency、工具時間、cache-pressure threshold、重複次數與數值 TTFT 降幅未載明；系統亦支援 Ollama，但其不屬 schema canonical engine tag。

metrics_defined.en: Wall-clock duration, mean completion time, estimated inference cost, and TTFT CDF for request-level versus workflow-level flushing; the paper does not state a numeric TTFT reduction.
metrics_defined.zh: Wall-clock duration、mean completion time、estimated inference cost，以及 request-level 與 workflow-level flushing 的 TTFT CDF；論文未提供數值 TTFT 降幅。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Stage mapping lowers mean completion time by 60%, wall-clock time by 38%, and estimated cost by 35%; cache management is tested on only five DAG-MATH problems and reports no numeric TTFT magnitude.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: Stage mapping 將 mean completion time 降低 60%、wall-clock time 降低 38%、estimated cost 降低 35%；cache management 僅在五個 DAG-MATH problems 上測試，且未提供數值 TTFT 幅度。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: Orla assumes developers declare the stage DAG and dependencies before execution; data-dependent stage outputs may alter hints, but newly created stages or edges are outside that plan.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: Orla 假設開發者於執行前宣告 stage DAG 與 dependencies；data-dependent stage output 可改變 hint，但新建立的 stage 或 edge 不在既有 plan 內。
